snippet.title: Festival of Ninjas | New Club Penguin
snippet.description:
The Festival of Ninjas is coming this week to New Club Penguin! This party is going to feature new minigames, new quests and, and exciting new character.

Master All Elements over at:
https://play.newcp.net
